portfolio: Synthetic holdings and risk parameters using public company names. Not real transactions or current credit ratings.
public_replay: Historical attributed excerpts. Dates use date-level knowledge with illustrative 18:00 UTC normalization; not exact event times. No social posts in this replay.
public_feed_snapshot: Saved public RSS news/social titles, preserved source URLs and feed timestamps. Not live when replayed.
public_eval: 13 builder-labelled public excerpts/titles; source URLs and text disjoint from replay/snapshot. Labels involve interpretation, especially sentiment. Not blinded or representative; pretraining contamination possible.
synthetic: news_feed, social_feed, eval_set and challenge_set are authored synthetic text. Fictional scenarios involving public company names do not assert actual events.
licensing: Short excerpts for attribution/evaluation; original publishers retain copyright. No confidential data. Social posts are unverified, not confirmed factual events.
sentiment_policy: Sentiment of expressed financial tone; policy decisions neutral unless wording includes favorable/unfavorable judgment. Launches and completed acquisitions labelled positive; other defensible labels possible.
public_datasets: Original immutable public sentiment/topic CSV releases; provenance, hashes and original cards in data/public/.
sentiment_benchmark: 240 publisher-labelled validation texts, balanced 80/class, normalized training overlap excluded. Training-only vocabulary/model; development-only C selection.
event_benchmark: 108 keyword-enriched builder-curated validation texts across five event types plus Other. Not representative, independent or blinded. Dummy timestamp documented.
trained_model: Portable supervised TF-IDF/logistic model fitted on 7545 train texts, selected on 1887 development texts.
prediction_cache: Actual recorded semantic/reference predictions; revisions and prompt hash verified; no claims of live inference on replay.
market_check: Six exploratory priority scores vs SPY unadjusted event-day close-to-close returns; Yahoo source/hash metadata. Not forecast calibration.
fresh_text_regression: Authored regression cases exercise unseen wording and review controls. They were used to verify fixes and are not independent real-headline accuracy evidence.
